findings.evidence: `ConstantMap.lean:35`, `:51`, `:61`, `:71`, `:80`, `:89` all prove laws about declarations defined in `Map.lean`; `Map.lean:35-47` already contains `GenLoop.map` and `GenLoop.map_const`, and `Map.lean:99-160` contains `HomotopyGroup.map`, `map_mk`, `mapHom`, and `mapHom_apply`.
findings.fix: Move these lemmas into `TauCeti/Topology/Homotopy/HomotopyGroup/Map.lean` near `GenLoop.map_const`, `HomotopyGroup.map_mk`, and `mapHom_apply`; remove the new file/import.
findings.issue: The declarations in this new file are canonical simp/elimination lemmas for `GenLoop.map`, `HomotopyGroup.map`, and `mapHom`, so placing them in a separate `ConstantMap` file leaves core map API away from the definitions it elaborates.

summary: The new API is useful, but it is split into a separate file even though all declarations are direct constant/subsingleton laws for the existing homotopy-group map API.
